reference: Independent literal line-array and hex byte-array edit histories derived from the public undo/buf contract, including inverse ordering, branch invalidation and a two-record depth cap. No GNU CLI parity is claimed.
coverage: Bash reports the registered undo loadable as a builtin.
The Bash help entry advertises the documented verbs, grouped history, branch clearing, and opaque byte policy.
Independent state contracts cover line records, binary byte records, grouped ordering/redo branches, and bounded history lifecycle.
Executed line and byte undo/redo, grouped ordering, branch invalidation, bounded-depth eviction and history lifecycle contracts.
exclusions: Automatic time-window coalescing, allocation-fault injection and editor terminal integration remain unqualified; no privileged environment is needed for the covered in-memory API.

cases.purpose: Bash type -t reports the registered loadable as a builtin, as required for an enabled Bash builtin.
Check that Bash help exposes the documented undo verbs and key history/byte contracts without invoking an operation.
cases.script:
doc=$(help undo)
[[ $doc == *'undo new -h HVAR -B BUF_SLOT [-d DEPTH]'* ]]
[[ $doc == *'undo record HANDLE TYPE LINENO [COL] TEXT [-X]'* ]]
[[ $doc == *'undo begin-group HANDLE'* && $doc == *'undo end-group HANDLE'* ]]
[[ $doc == *'undo redo HANDLE'* && $doc == *'undo clear HANDLE'* && $doc == *'undo depth HANDLE'* ]]
[[ $doc == *'record clears redo history (new branch)'* ]]
[[ $doc == *'opaque byte string'* && $doc == *'byte-buffer-indexed'* ]]
printf 'undo help covers verbs, grouping, branches, and byte policy\n'
cases.stdout: undo help covers verbs, grouping, branches, and byte policy

cases.purpose: Fixed line-array contract checks insert, delete, changed-line inverse/redo and exact depth transitions.
cases.script:
buf new -h b
undo new -h u -B "$b" -d 2
buf insert-line "$b" 0 alpha
undo record "$u" I 0 alpha
undo depth "$u"
undo undo "$u"
buf lines "$b"
undo depth "$u"
undo redo "$u"
buf line "$b" 0
buf delete-line "$b" 0
undo record "$u" D 0 alpha
undo undo "$u"
buf line "$b" 0
buf delete-line "$b" 0
buf insert-line "$b" 0 beta
undo record "$u" C 0 alpha
undo undo "$u"
buf line "$b" 0
undo redo "$u"
buf line "$b" 0
undo free "$u"
buf free "$b"

cases.purpose: Independent hex byte-array states validate UTF-8 bytes and NUL transit through insertion/removal undo and redo.
cases.script:
buf new -h b
undo new -h u -B "$b" -d 2
buf insert-line "$b" 0 410042 -X
buf insert-at "$b" 0 1 c3a9 -X
undo record "$u" A 0 1 c3a9 -X
buf line "$b" 0 -X
undo undo "$u"
buf line "$b" 0 -X
undo redo "$u"
buf line "$b" 0 -X
buf delete-at "$b" 0 3 1
undo record "$u" R 0 3 00 -X
undo undo "$u"
buf line "$b" 0 -X
undo redo "$u"
buf line "$b" 0 -X

cases.purpose: Grouped dependent edits reverse in inverse order, replay forward and a new branch invalidates redo.
cases.script:
buf new -h b
undo new -h u -B "$b" -d 2
undo begin-group "$u"
buf insert-line "$b" 0 first
undo record "$u" I 0 first
buf insert-line "$b" 1 second
undo record "$u" I 1 second
undo end-group "$u"
undo depth "$u"
undo undo "$u"
buf lines "$b"
undo redo "$u"
buf text "$b" -X
undo undo "$u"
undo begin-group "$u"
buf insert-line "$b" 0 branch
undo record "$u" I 0 branch
undo end-group "$u"
undo depth "$u"
if undo redo "$u"; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf 'redo=%s\n' "$rc"
buf line "$b" 0

cases.purpose: A depth cap of two evicts the oldest record; empty-stack, clear, empty group, free and reallocation retain the documented state.
cases.script:
buf new -h b
undo new -h u -B "$b" -d 2
for value in one two three; do
 count=$(buf lines "$b")
 buf insert-line "$b" "$count" "$value"
 undo record "$u" I "$count" "$value"
done
undo depth "$u"
undo undo "$u"
undo undo "$u"
if undo undo "$u"; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf 'empty=%s\n' "$rc"
buf line "$b" 0
undo clear "$u"
undo depth "$u"
undo begin-group "$u"
undo end-group "$u"
undo depth "$u"
undo free "$u"
undo new -h v -B "$b"
undo depth "$v"
undo free "$v"
buf free "$b"
